verdicts.reason: I couldn't find a meaningful difference between the two; B is just the same layout shifted a few pixels left. Both have the same problems: a decorative rule cuts through "MODERN" in the headline, and the quote is jammed against the top of the red panel, leaving a large empty red area below it. The author name floats off to the right instead of sitting under the quote, and the skyline (the key image) has shrunk to a small strip in a separate white box, so the layered skyline-over-panel feel of the original is gone.
